# miraat

> Find & fix the RTL bugs AI code tools introduce — across Arabic, Hebrew, Syriac, Thaana, N'Ko and Adlam.

miraat (مرآة, "mirror"; formerly rtlint) is a low-dependency CLI + MCP server that scans
React / Next / Tailwind / CSS for right-to-left mistakes AI code generators make — physical
CSS/Tailwind (`ml-4`, `text-left`, `margin-left`), hard-coded `dir="ltr"`, un-mirrored
directional icons, script-blind fonts, Western digits in native-numeral scripts — auto-fixes
the mechanical ones, and flags the rest for a human. Physical→logical, dir and mirrored-icon
guidance fire for every RTL script; the numeral check keys off a Unicode scripts table so it
only fires where the script has its own numerals (Arabic, Thaana, N'Ko, Adlam) and never on
Hebrew or Syriac.

## Use it
- CLI: `npx github:Otto-OttoSpace/miraat . --fix` (the `rtlint` command still works)
- MCP server: run `miraat-mcp` (tools: `miraat_scan`, `miraat_check_code`; `rtlint_*` / `rtl_*` aliases) so agents call it in-loop
- AI rule file: `miraat --init-rules` writes RTL-RULES.md

## Rules for any agent writing RTL UI
Use logical CSS (`margin-inline-start`, `text-align: start`) and logical Tailwind
(`ms-/me-/ps-/pe-/start-/end-/text-start`). Set `dir` dynamically. Mirror directional
icons only. Use a script-capable font with a fallback; body >= 16px, line-height >= 1.5.
